overview.text: 四 means “four.” Its current form has enclosing 囗 strokes around inner 儿 strokes. Its origin is disputed: it may be a direct numeral graph or a graph later borrowed for “four.”

components.text: 囗 forms the enclosing outer shape in the present graph.
儿 identifies the inner strokes in the present graph; their ancient role is unresolved.
